description.value: Asian Pear Buffet is an all-you-can-eat Chinese and Western cuisine restaurant on Harvey Avenue in Kelowna, with over 100 menu items spanning both culinary traditions. The buffet format makes it an appealing option for hungry touring cyclists looking to seriously refuel after a day on the Okanagan's cycling routes. The restaurant also offers takeout and delivery for those who prefer a grab-and-go approach.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms an active all-you-can-eat buffet at 2050 Harvey Ave, Kelowna, BC with phone (250) 868-0038. Takeout and pickup are explicitly confirmed via multiple website passages ('Order for Pickup or Delivery', 'Download Takeout Menu', '10% off on restaurant pickups'). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both were sourced solely from the website (2050 Harvey Ave, Kelowna, BC; (250) 868-0038) and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate sit-down buffet restaurant that could serve touring cyclists well, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence; a site visit or direct contact is needed before including.
